key.merge: A guest-to-account merge re-keys the facts to the Account or leaves the anonymous facts invalidated by mergedIntoAccountId; the Account key never reads anonymous facts.

lifecycle.drift: The before-confirm read rejects a sourceRevision that differs from the readiness read before any side effect.

dimensions.readyWhen: Exactly one fact for the requested labelPreference at the key's owner and shipFromLocationId, evaluated at the record revision, reports it available.
Exactly one provider route fact for the requested labelPreference at the key's owner and shipFromLocationId, evaluated at the record revision, reports it available.

blockingFacts.missing: No facts for the key's owner and Ship-From Location, no fact for the requested labelPreference, or a key that cannot name an owner fact.
blockingFacts.stale: The fact was evaluated at an older revision than its record, or a guest-to-account merge invalidated the anonymous owner's facts.
blockingFacts.conflicting: The record names another owner or Ship-From Location, holds more than one fact for the requested labelPreference, or holds a fact ahead of its record revision.
blockingFacts.unavailable: The fact reports the preference or provider route unavailable, or the facts could not be read.
